featured_reviews.name: Rohan Kini
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is an ice cream joint located in Dahisar that has also been featured by several YouTube creators. The place has limited seating—around 5–6 people inside and a similar capacity outside.

We visited on a weekend night, and it was surprisingly quiet with hardly anyone around. The staff, however, was welcoming and pleasant to interact with.

We ordered five items: gulkand ice cream, tender coconut ice cream, baklava, and two waffles—one hazelnut and one KitKat.

Starting with the ice creams, the gulkand flavor was quite sweet but had a natural taste overall, even though sugar is added. The tender coconut ice cream was disappointing and not up to the mark. It should not be compared with Natural Ice Creams, as it doesn’t come close in terms of flavor or authenticity.

The baklava was unique and enjoyable. It was topped with pista and honey, which complemented it well and made it taste quite good.

Coming to the waffles, although they were prepared fresh, there was an unpleasant smell either from the waffle base or the chocolate. The hazelnut waffle was still acceptable, but the KitKat waffle was not good and didn’t work for me.

Bonus tip : If any ukdiche Modak lovers then they have that flavour too , unique .
Also they have some offeres if you order from their sites do checkout !!

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Khamkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nilyano Ice Cream Shop is a perfect place for dessert lovers 🍦✨
Located in a convenient and easy-to-reach area, the shop offers a beautiful ambiance with a clean and cozy seating arrangement, making it a great spot to relax with friends and family.

They have a huge variety of ice creams, sundaes, shakes, faloodas, waffles, and delicious desserts. From classic chocolate and vanilla to unique fruity and premium flavors, every item tastes fresh, creamy, and rich in quality. Their presentation and serving style are also very attractive.

The staff is polite, friendly, and provides quick service. The hygiene and cleanliness of the shop are well maintained, which makes the overall experience even better.

If you are looking for a place with amazing taste, good location, and lots of dessert options, Nilyano Ice Cream Shop is definitely worth visiting ❤️🍨 Highly recommended for all ice cream lovers!

featured_reviews.name: Atharv Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nilyano Ice Cream is truly a delight for every dessert lover! The texture is incredibly smooth and creamy, and every flavor feels rich and perfectly balanced. You can tell they use high-quality ingredients because the taste is fresh and authentic in every bite.

What I loved the most is the variety of flavors-they have something for everyone, from classic favorites to unique options. The sweetness level is just right, not too overpowering, making it enjoyable even for regular indulgence.

The presentation and quality make it perfect for family treats, outings, or even special occasions. Once you try Nilyano Ice Cream, it's hard to go back to anything else!

Highly recommended for all ice cream lovers!

featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved the desserts! The Royale Rose Falooda, Biscoff Caramel Sundae, and Golden Biscoff were rich and delicious. featured_reviews.name: CA. Nitin Poojary
featured_reviews.review_text:
Apsara Ice Cream in Dahisar East is a fantastic spot if you are looking for high-quality, dense, and naturally flavored ice creams. They have a great reputation for a reason, and they definitely deliver on taste.

The Flavors: Their fruit flavors are exceptional. The Guava Glory (complete with the sprinkle of chili powder on top) is an absolute must-try, and their seasonal mango and roasted almond flavors are incredibly rich and creamy. You can tell they use genuine ingredients without that artificial aftertaste.

The Texture: The ice cream is dense, perfectly churned, and has a great mouthfeel. It feels much more premium and artisanal than standard commercial brands.

Ambience & Service: The outlet is clean, well-maintained, and the staff is quite patient and happy to let you sample flavors before you make up your mind.

I visited Dessert Junction this Sunday and had a wonderful experience. We were warmly welcomed by Mr. Ritesh, who also guided us with recommendations based on our taste preferences, which added a nice personal touch.

We began with the Sizzling Brownie with Ice Cream – the brownie was soft, rich, and paired perfectly with the ice cream, making it an indulgent treat. Following his suggestion, we tried the Trio Sundae, a delightful mix of vanilla ice cream, hot chocolate sauce, brownie chunks, and dry fruits, topped with an Oreo biscuit. It was absolutely delicious and a perfect choice for chocolate lovers.

The service was quick, and the ambience felt cozy and welcoming. They also offer a range of vegetarian snacks, making it more than just a dessert spot.

Overall, Dessert Junction is definitely a go-to place if you’re craving desserts with warm hospitality.

featured_reviews.name: Sharan Rai
featured_reviews.review_text:
House of Siri is a wonderful place if you’re looking for healthy yet delicious food. The millet waffle was excellent—crispy on the outside, soft inside, and perfectly balanced in flavor. It’s great to see millet used in such a tasty way.

The pizza was also very impressive, with fresh ingredients, a nice crust, and a rich, satisfying taste. You can really tell they focus on quality and wholesome options.

The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the service is friendly. Overall, a great spot for anyone who enjoys nutritious food without compromising on taste. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Kini
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried a cute little vegan café in Dahisar West on World Vegan Day, and it was quite an experience!

We ordered their Millet Ice Cream and Farmhouse Pizza .

To be honest, the millet ice cream wasn’t my favourite. The taste is very different from what we’re used to with regular ice creams, and since it was my first time trying a vegan millet version, it definitely felt like an acquired taste. The pricing is similar to premium ice creams, so you need to be someone who genuinely enjoys or is open to vegan alternatives to appreciate it fully.

The pizza, on the other hand, was impressive! 🍕
It was heavy, filling, and absolutely worth the price. They don’t use maida – the base is made with jowar and bajra, so the texture may feel slightly different, but the flavours were spot on.

They mentioned they’ll soon be introducing sugar-free vegan ice creams too, and they also offer home delivery. The owner was super friendly and guided us through the menu, which was really helpful.
Would definitely go back for the pizza !!

featured_reviews.name: Bhavit shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best place to have millet ice-cream and vegan pizzas. Do try their red guava ice-cream with chilli sprinkler.  A must visit venu 🌶

featured_reviews.name: Asmartclick India
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Delightful Treat Every Time!

Siri Ice Cream is truly a hidden gem for ice cream lovers! Every scoop bursts with rich flavor, perfect texture, and creamy consistency that’s simply irresistible. Their variety is impressive from classic vanilla and chocolate to unique regional flavors that you don’t find elsewhere.

What stands out most is the quality and freshness you can actually taste the difference in every bite. The ingredients feel pure, and the ice cream isn’t overly sweet, which makes it enjoyable for all age groups.

The service is friendly, the portions are generous, and the presentation is always top-notch. Whether you’re looking for a quick dessert, a family outing, or a sweet indulgence on a hot day, Siri Ice Cream never disappoints. Highly recommended! 🍦💖
